messages:
maya: FYI we got a reseller question from CloudWave — their AWS marketplace charges show as 'unattributed' in our ledger for Mar 1-7.
aj: Unattributed how? like no customer tag mapping on the marketplace metering report?
maya: Exactly. The marketplace 'BuyerReference' field seems to be set to the partner account id, not the downstream customer tag we expect. So our ETL can't map to customer ids.
leo-fin: Ouch. That will break customer P&L and reseller commissions. Do we have a quick sample of one of those invoices?
sophia: I pulled one example and attached the metering CSV to the ticket. Snippet below:
```
TransactionId,UsageStart,UsageEnd,BuyerReference,ProductCode,Quantity,Cost
t-01,2026-03-01,2026-03-01,cloudwave-aws-acc-999,redwood-llm,1200,24.00
```
maya: We expect BuyerReference to be like cw-cust-<customer-id> or include tags in the TagSet column. It's missing.
channel-partner-ops: CloudWave says they supply us a mapping file but it looks like their integration flipped to using their master account id during a config change on 2026-02-28.
aj: Can eng/etl confirm where we look up BuyerReference -> internal_customer_id? Is it in marketplace-ingest service?
sophia: Yes, marketplace-ingest has mapping in s3://billing-mappings/marketplace/aws/buyer_to_customer.csv and the lambda uses BuyerReference key. If the buyer string is the partner account we don't have entries for downstream customers.
leo-fin: For the short term we need a reconciliation path and a manual credit for affected customers. Can we compute affected usage per downstream customer from partner file CloudWave provided?
channel-partner-ops: They sent a delta mapping file for Mar 1-7 with columns: downstream_customer_tag, usage_qty. I'll attach to the ticket.
aj: Engineering note — we could add a fallback where if BuyerReference matches a known partner pattern, we cross-reference the partner-provided mapping file for that partner and date range.
sophia: Quick query we ran to find unattributed rows:
```
SELECT BuyerReference, SUM(Quantity) as qty, SUM(Cost) as cost
FROM marketplace_raw.aws_usage
WHERE invoice_date >= '2026-03-01' AND invoice_date <= '2026-03-07'
AND BuyerReference NOT IN (SELECT buyer FROM buyer_to_customer)
GROUP BY BuyerReference;
```
maya: Results: partner account cloudwave-aws-acc-999 => qty 18,400 tokens, cost $368.00 across 14 invoices.
leo-fin: Proposed action items:
- Finance to create provisional credits to downstream customers using CloudWave's mapping file (manual journal entries)
- Ops to request partner to toggle back mapping or re-run reports with tags
- Eng to add a short-term fallback path + longer-term validation alerts
aj: I can take the eng task. ETA for fallback patch? ~48 hours if mapping file schema is stable.
channel-partner-ops: CloudWave agreed to re-run their metering export with downstream BuyerReference for Mar 1-7 and also provided the mapping. They also approved provisional PO for credits.
maya: For the credit memos, finance needs a CSV of downstream_customer_id, affected_cost, invoice_period, partner_ref. Leo, can you confirm format? We will push credits once partners sign off.
leo-fin: Format confirmed. I'll produce with GL codes and send for approval today.
sophia: Eng follow-up: adding a pre-ingest validation check that alerts when >5% of daily usage is unattributed. I will open a PR and add metrics to the ingestion runbook.
aj: PR drafted, tests added. I'll coordinate a canary deploy to staging and then prod if all good.
maya: Thanks all. Tagging @gcp-billing-bot for audit log capture.
gcp-billing-bot: audit: ticket-6123 attached, mapping-file cloudwave_mar1-7.csv uploaded to /evidence/ticket-6123/ at 2026-03-10T14:01:12Z :white_check_mark:
leo-fin: Once CloudWave re-runs and we reconcile, we will close the credits loop. Keeping this thread open until confirmed.
maya: Marking as actioned in JIRA with link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/BILL-6123 :memo:
